admission.justification: Proved by test_render_refuses_publish_when_kit_licence_notice_is_missing and prevents publishing a page carrying third-party kit assets without their required licence notice.

applicability: Explainer render and publish invocations that carry referenced pinned kit libraries through carry_kit_assets.
conditions: kit_result.kit_problems is non-empty because a referenced kit library lacks its required licence notice or fails shipped-kit verification.
exclusions: Explainer drafts that reference no pinned kit files and carry no kit/ assets.
statement: The explainer publish path reads kit_result.kit_problems and refuses publication with those problem messages when a referenced kit library lacks its licence notice.
title: Explainer publication refuses kit libraries that lack a licence notice
